title: Tonelli–Fatou: lower left difference quotients have a.e. finite liminf over j
statement: Let μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be Borel measures on ℝ, let a, b ∈ ℝ and let Λ ∈ [0, ∞) satisfy μ_j([a, b]) ≤ Λ for every j. For t ∈ ℝ and j ∈ ℕ let S_j(t) := liminf_{h→0+} ENNReal.ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ_j((t − h, t)) ∈ [0, ∞] (limit inferior in [0, ∞] along h → 0 with h > 0, i.e. along the filter 𝓝[>] 0). Then for Lebesgue-almost every t ∈ ℝ: if a < t < b, then liminf_{j→∞} S_j(t) ≠ ∞ (limit inferior in [0, ∞] along atTop in ℕ).
lean_statement: ∀ (μ : ℕ → Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), Λ ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, μ j (Icc a b) ≤ Λ) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → liminf (fun j => liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ j (Ioo (t - h) t)) (𝓝[>] 0)) atTop ≠ ∞
